_about: Towns that get a Places page, by area. Coordinates come from build/directory/towns.json, so every name here must be in that file. Services within 'radius_miles' of the town are listed: one of the In person tab's distances (2, 5, 10 or 20), so 'In person view' shows the same area. 'label_left': towns whose name goes to the left of their pin on the Places map, so names don't run off the edge or overlap.
